notes.subject: ol tok bilong yu bilong wokim
notes.rationale: פקודים em i ol samting God i makim long man bilong wokim; Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok — mi opim long ol tok

notes.subject: dispela i kamap long mi
notes.rationale: זאת היתה לי: 'dispela i bilong mi' o 'em i stap long mi' — ol tanim tok i no wankain; BSB i gat 'practice'

translation: Dispela i kamap long mi, bilong olten em i olsem, long wanem, mi lukautim ol tok bilong yu bilong wokim.

tokens.gloss: ol tok bilong yu bilong wokim
